name: figure1_signature_heatmap
caption: Receptor class signature across aging biomarkers, grouped by hallmark domain. Cell fill and the printed value are the direction adjusted pooled percent change, positive toward a younger biomarker profile. Cells marked n/e were not estimable. No biomarker pools within GLP-1 / GIP / GCG, so that column is empty throughout.

name: figure4_weight_adjusted_liverfat
caption: Liver fat percent change against mean body weight change, one point per pooled trial arm that carries the body weight covariate. 7 of the 9 pooled liver fat arms carry the body weight covariate and are plotted; 2 are not. Point area is inverse variance and point shape is receptor class. The line and band are the random effects meta-regression reported in Table 4a.

name: figure5_nbais
caption:
Net Biological Age Impact Score by receptor class under three weighting schemes, computed over the 11 markers of the prespecified inclusion rule. Bars are the weighted mean direction adjusted percent change; error bars are the percentile interval of the two level bootstrap.
GLP-1 / GIP / GCG: no biomarker pools within the class, so there is nothing to average.
GLP-1 / GCG (1): fewer than 3 of the 11 markers named by the composite inclusion rule pool within the class, so no composite is computed.

name: figure2_forest_overall
caption: Forest plot of the overall pooled percent change per aging biomarker across all incretin receptor classes, ordered by effect. Squares are pooled estimates, bars 95 per cent confidence intervals.

name: figure6_rob_summary
caption: Risk of bias across the five RoB-2 domains and the overall judgement, as the share of assessed trials. Glyphs accompany every colour so the judgement does not depend on colour.

name: figureS1_rob_traffic_light
caption: Per trial RoB-2 traffic light for all 77 assessed trials, supplementary to Figure 6.
